lines.text: Wait! How 1 Fluffy Cloud Weighs as Much as 100 Elephants!
Most kids guess totally wrong about why do clouds float!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
A fluffy cumulus cloud holds huge water weight spread over.
trillions of microscopic droplets that rise easily on warm air currents.
Nature uses amazing science tricks right under our noses!
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind 100 Elephant Cloud!
